name: Stock Valuation — Drive -> Google Sheet (Daily 8am IST)

nodes.name: List Files In Drive Folder
nodes.notes: Verify after import: this must list the files inside https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/13Tl4zDtMKzaOko5PCU6cgsK_Ao6KeTlb only, not the whole Drive. Attach the Google Drive OAuth2 credential after import — none is pre-wired.

parameters.content:
## No new file today
The newest file in the Drive folder is the same one already processed on the last run (same Drive file id + modifiedTime). Stopping here on purpose — brief §Stage 2: a run that quietly reuses yesterday's file is worse than one that is down. This is NOT an error; it means TCS iON hasn't dropped a fresh export yet today.

nodes.name: Extract From File
nodes.notes: Native binary xlsx extraction — the same node type dpr-workflow.json already uses. NOT a Code-node xlsx import: n8n Cloud's Code sandbox disallows require('xlsx'), which this deliberately avoids.

nodes.name: Bundle Rows (collapse to 1 item)
nodes.notes: Same cleaning logic as dpr-workflow.json's node of the same name — copied verbatim on purpose, not reinvented.

nodes.name: Clear Old Data
nodes.notes: Same documentId + sheetName as dpr-workflow.json's node of the same name, copied byte-for-byte — this MUST land on the identical stock_valuation tab, not a lookalike.

nodes.name: Sync stock_valuation_columns via Apps Script
nodes.notes: Paste the SAME Apps Script Web App URL already live in dpr-workflow.json's node of this name — do not deploy a second Web App. This call is additive; it does not modify that script.
